remaining_concerns: This role still has only summary-level evidence and not the underlying excerpts for BMCARD-046-A through BMCARD-046-E.
The material predicates for certification remain indirectly asserted rather than directly supported in the admissible record available here.
The numeric threshold and slice-gap claims are still not independently verifiable from the evidence available to this role.

final_rationale: No genuinely new admissible evidence was provided. The Actor narrowed the position from an overbroad certification theory to a disclosure-based, policy-bounded theory, and that reinterpretation is more defensible than clean certification. But under the preregistered criteria, that is not enough to move to compliant_with_caveats because the missing support is not merely a disclosure caveat about operations; it is an unresolved audit predicate about whether the cited evidence directly establishes each required fact. The provided policy text does support the general proposition that certification can proceed if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes exposure, and it confirms that aggregate pass rates do not erase subgroup weaknesses. Even so, this role still cannot independently verify from admissible evidence the concrete factual predicates the Actor relies on: aggregate threshold clearance, the subgroup weakness and its materiality, the absence of an approved mitigation, and the sampling-based follow-up rationale. The direction is plausible and more tightly framed, but the support links remain missing in the admissible record available to this role, so the verdict remains suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats.
